appearance_facts.fact: Vermont (VT) is filled with the darkest maroon color on the map, matching the low end of the legend scale.
Utah (UT) is filled with a very pale yellow/cream color, matching the high end of the legend scale.
Delaware (DE) is filled with a light yellow color, also near the high end of the legend scale.
Washington (WA) and South Dakota (SD) are also filled with dark maroon, similar to Vermont.
Several states including Indiana (IN), Tennessee (TN), and Mississippi (MS) are filled with dark red, indicating low-to-moderate values.

printed_facts.fact: The vertical color bar is labeled 'High' at the top (100) and 'Low' at the bottom (0), with tick marks at 20, 40, 60, and 80.
The top of the scale (100) is pale yellow, indicating high risk index values.
The bottom of the scale (0) is dark maroon, indicating low risk index values.
Vermont is labeled 'VT' and is colored dark maroon, corresponding to a value near 0 on the scale.
Utah is labeled 'UT' and is colored pale yellow, corresponding to a value near 100 on the scale.
Delaware is labeled 'DE' and is colored light yellow, corresponding to a value between 80 and 100 on the scale.
